title: 30A Wonderland at Treetop | KEY.co
description_expanded: Experience the epitome of coastal luxury at this stunning beach house in the exclusive gated community of Treetop Village, Seacrest. This spacious five-bedroom, four-and-a-half-bathroom home is thoughtfully designed with exquisite furnishings and detailed woodwork, featuring shiplap walls, hardwood floors, and quartz countertops. Enjoy the privacy of lush landscaping as you relax on the spacious covered decks or take a dip in the community pool. With two master suites, three additional well-appointed bedrooms, and ample living space including a fully equipped kitchen and dining area, this home is perfect for gatherings of family and friends. Treetop Village offers an ideal 30A location, nestled between Alys and Rosemary Beach, with easy access to the pristine beach via tram service. Your stay includes the use of a golf cart and four bikes, making it easy to explore the charming nearby restaurants and shops. This pet-friendly retreat also features modern amenities like Smart TVs in every room, a gas grill, an outdoor shower, and a screened-in deck with games and seating. Whether lounging by the heated saltwater pool, cruising to the beach, or enjoying a family barbecue, this home promises an unforgettable and luxurious coastal getaway.
